venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Sat 9/19 (MOD JK).** Net $6,555 vs $9,009 target (73%); food $265; event $0; comps $81.70; 200 guests / $32.78 avg. Weather 92/73 with heavy rain. Rainy Saturday on day two of Shaky Knees; opener and mid welcomed early guests — reminder to tell daytime guests about the night DJ. Got hit hard with rain around 7pm which disrupted guest flow; kitchen closed a little before 9pm. Plastic cups back on deck; all hands on deck for glassware. Smooth night overall. No 86s, no maintenance needs, no incident, no-shows not charged. Favorite: a visit from James, who travels between states posting about the bars. Entered by Mya.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Sat 9/19 (MOD KE/MD/KK/DM).** Net $10,113 vs $11,905 target (85%); food $613; comps $107.20 (1%; BINGO winners and employee purchases); ~374 guests / $27.04 avg. Weather hot. Crept up to $10k — still hovering at $8k at midnight but guests kept coming between midnight and 2am, a late influx where it normally falls off. Ran with the all-new crew (Annie, Clay, Edy back as bartender, Sara barbacking) and held it down. Kitchen: great food sales with a clear positive impact on revenue and guest experience; guests raved about the wings and classic dog. No 86s, no incident, no-shows not charged. Favorite: a late-night group of four (Tori and Jeremy) raving about how well the team takes care of them. Entered by KE.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Sat 9/19 (AM Maggie H.; PM Carey + Lucas).** Net incl. events $32,609.60 vs $18,315 target (178%); DC/AM $1,489.25, D&C PM $13,602.35, Garden n/a; non-event net $15,091.60; event net $17,518 (event food $9,430); total food incl. events $12,231.60; comps $591.26 (3.93%); 383 guests (Tock) / ~$85.14 avg. Weather dark and stormy. AM: fun, not-super-busy Saturday with Felix and Care (cold brew started), only a few IRDs — thank you Heather. PM: 'Wacky Waving Inflatable Arm Tube Night' — down a host and a closer, team pivoted seamlessly and event staff jumped in to help the short-handed close. Kitchen: steady night for Rand and Fiellah; Lucas and Rachel killed the event — thank you Ayu. Event: Rachael & Paul wedding ceremony/reception, 85 guests, 4:30–10pm in all spaces; weather held for the ceremony, massive family-style dinner ran smoothly, planner and group thanked the team — thank you Kelly. Break make-up complete. No-shows not charged. **Incident/injury reported: Yes** (no detail given in form). No maintenance needs. Favorite: a night with the makings of a dumpster fire that the team crushed with quick pivots and communication. Entered by Carey.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.weather: Last 80s day of the year, breezy
venues.narrative: **EV — Sat 9/19 (MOD Kyler; Chef Steves).** Net incl. events $15,341 vs $7,720 target (199%); D&C net excl. events $2,603 (food $201, beverage $2,376, retail $26); event sales $12,738; comps $136.65; 87 guests (Sevenrooms, pre-event covers) / $30 avg. Weather: last 80s day of the year leading into breezy autumn. Slow-build opening with a flip around 7:15 that never hit critical mass, as the room was kept gentle to accommodate reservations ahead of the event; bespoke service with high-end calls. Event: Randy 'went savage mode' — fun, varied crowd. 0 investor cocktails, 87 pre-event covers, 3 solos, 0 large parties. Top sellers: Native Lion, Rosalie, Eight Limb Daiquiri. Kitchen: event food tonight. Menu count 18. Breakage: 1 cheater, 1 N&N chipped. No-shows not charged. Maintenance: downstairs bathroom needs plunger. Entered by Thomas.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Sat 9/19 (MOD Julian, Gianna, Saleh, Josh).** Net $14,397 vs $13,123 target (110%); food $2,796; Standing Room $3,212 (food $500), Marquee $11,185 (food $2,296); event $0; comps $723; 351 guests / $41.81 avg. Weather started warm, a tad chilly at night. Busy from open with guests arriving right at opening and stayed busy through close; all hands on deck the whole shift with plenty of reservations dropping in. Built a hefty waitlist and worked through it; kitchen stayed past last call, group of 8 arrived just before doors closed and food orders ran to last call. Plenty of new guests enjoying the space. Kitchen: full staff, busy to the end. Maintenance: tile by host stand loose. 86 tofu, low champagne. No incident; no-shows charged. Favorite: communication between security and host was awesome. Entered by Julian Catano.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Sat 9/19 (MOD Josh).** Net incl. events $16,674.69 vs $9,611 target (173%); Marquee bar $8,403.69, Garden $231 (private event/buyout), food $896.50, total non-event $8,634.69; event sales $8,040; comps $159.42, voids $2,665.20; guest count not entered on form (GCA reported $38.18, CA $88.22). Weather nice. Busy night — strong first couple of hours, hard lull 7–8pm, then ramped quickly with walk-ins, larger-party reservations and industry friends in town for events. Full Garden buyout required tight comms to keep the Marquee moving; started a waitlist and worked through it fairly quickly. Floor service good but ticket pacing, ringing correct items and running food/drinks had avoidable mistakes. Bar top full most of the night with multiple rounds; team pushed food and bev while building genuine guest connections. Kitchen: buyout ran alongside Marquee service with only one BOH scheduled; Rassan and MOD hustled, food out in reasonable time and to spec. Went well: comms, teamwork, connections. Do better: running food/drinks, clearing KDS, event staffing, clean work areas. Maintenance: hot water heater, curtains, garbage disposal. No incident; no-shows not charged. Favorite: a couple in from Seattle excited about D&C there. Entered by Josh.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Sat 9/19 (AM Justin + Shannon; PM Justin/James + Marcus).** Net $15,227 vs $14,826 target (103%); Municipal Bar AM $3,880 / PM $9,060, Sun Club $462, Hot Eye $1,786; food $643 (as reported); event $0; comps $224; 404 guests (OpenTable 131 AM + 273 PM) / ~$37.69 avg. Weather hot and clear. AM: great, steady Saturday day shift with lots of folks in town enjoying the weather — James. PM: busy because of the Philharmonic; huge hours 6–8pm for the biggest numbers in quite some time; down a server assistant but the shift felt great, everyone bringing their A-game — James. Sun Club: beautiful day, not crazy busy, lots of food orders at the start, mainly hotel guests by the pool, lots of passion fruit sodas. Hot Eye: slower Saturday for the first 2 hours, picked up at 9:30 and filled quickly then died out; out-of-town pops, decent SCAD, small industry crew for the last hour. Kitchen: great night, no notes. No incident. Favorite: a small Pinkie Masters crew stopped by THE for a nightcap. Entered by Alexis.

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.narrative: **SEA — Sat 9/19 (MOD JA / CH).** Net $12,729 vs $8,000 target (159%); food $2,046; comps/discounts $852 total (~$100 shifties, $150 F&F, rest owner/investor/DNL/SND); 261 guests / $48.77 avg. Weather great, a little chill. (Form date typed 9/20; matched by post time and day-of-week Saturday.) MOD spent a good bit of service in the prep dungeon — all good problems; nights feel smoother as time goes on, giving bandwidth to dial in SOPs and core values. DK came in. Lots of industry love on Saturdays; Curtis crushed it as talking head upstairs; many guests with high-minded questions. One walk-out — staff believe the guest knew his card would decline; suggest a pre-shift strategy discussion. Last call getting more organized. Kitchen: toast still too hard — experiment with thinner cut, less toasting or a new purveyor. Maintenance: fixed downstairs regulator; urgently need better rose hips for RBF. Low Wild Pink; more Chardonnay Monday. No incident; no-shows not charged. Favorite: Melinda, MOD's old co-worker from HRG, showed up. Entered by Julian Abel.
